# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering fixes and platform alignment**

## Highlights

The unreleased 4.156.0 line improves rendering correctness and updates Apple and Uno platform requirements. Android texture render loops follow display refresh, native callbacks use the correct boolean widths, and Linux HarfBuzz calls stay within the bundled library. The line also reduces allocations and fixes WebAssembly application linking.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, preserving any higher managed or framework requirements. These floors support Xcode 27 builds; .NET 9 targets remain available. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno applications to Uno Platform 7** — The non-Windows Uno views assembly now requires .NET 10 and Uno 7; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. Migrate to Uno.Sdk's .NET SDK WebAssembly path. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses a CPU surface, and returns a null GRContext on non-Windows Uno targets; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Remove uses of RaiseOnUnsupported, which was dropped. Windows facades retain the ANGLE-backed control. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Use rebuilt WebAssembly archives for WebGPU** — For consumers newer than .NET 8, WebGPU linking now requires rebuilt native archives containing the emdawnwebgpu C++ support. Replace pre-change or GPU-disabled custom archives with matching Graphite-enabled builds. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Use a single encoding unit for character-code conversion** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates encoded byte width rather than UTF-16 string length. Use Utf8 only for ASCII, Utf16 for a single BMP character, and Utf32 for supplementary characters. Empty, multi-character, and multi-unit inputs throw ArgumentException with ParamName set to character. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 correctness updates** — Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, corrects Ganesh GLES BGRA uploads, and prevents undersized conic-region storage and execution of partial shader pipelines. Graphite preserves styled hairline bounds and compares complete paint keys. These syncs do not change the milestone or managed API. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GL texture rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, drawing stays on the GL worker, and automatic rendering resumes correctly after render-mode transitions. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Native callback boolean widths corrected** — Skia callbacks use one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values while public managed signatures remain bool. This addresses Apple ARM64 interpreter return-value mismatches and correctly handles false-returning HarfBuzz font and Unicode callbacks. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order isolation** — Internal calls in bundled Linux HarfBuzz bind to its own functions, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls and mixing incompatible private objects. Exported entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **String conversion fixes** — Corrects single-unit Unicode character-code decoding and makes StringUtilities.GetString report ArgumentNullException for null byte arrays instead of NullReferenceException. FromCString also fixes a native buffer over-read. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **WebAssembly C and C++ linking compatibility** — WebGPU C++ support is compiled into libSkiaSharp.a, so application C sources no longer receive incompatible C++ flags during final linking. JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower allocation overhead** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention corrected** — Fixes retention behavior in front-buffered streams. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Windows integration dependencies refreshed** — WinUI ANGLE advances to chromium/8118, with matching PDB names for packaged DLLs. Windows library dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10 using Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. These updates do not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
